title: fix(app-shell): ActionParamDialog honours the spec `carryOver` param declaration — carried params render read-only and submit verbatim (objectui#6246)
body:
Fixes #6246
Clause-②: yes

UI half of the objectstack#11753 ruling (maintainer, recommendation A, 「同意」). The spec half, `ActionParamSchema.carryOver`, landed in objectstack#12614. This PR makes `ActionParamDialog` honour it: a param that declares `carryOver` renders as a **collapsed read-only summary**. It is seeded from the row, submitted verbatim, and has no field widget at all, so there is nothing to edit (the control is not just styled as read-only).

## Premise, measured before any edit

- **The key is installable here.** This worktree installs `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`. `grep -rl carryOver node_modules/@objectstack/spec/dist` hits `dist/ui/index.{js,mjs,d.ts,d.mts}` among others, which meets the `Restart-when:` on the card. The declared shape is `carryOver: z.ZodOptional(z.ZodBoolean)`, a plain optional boolean. A runtime probe against the installed `ActionParamSchema` accepts `{ field, defaultFromRow: true, carryOver: true }` and keeps `carryOver: true` in the parsed output. It refuses `carryOver: true` without `defaultFromRow` at path `carryOver`, and it refuses a string value.
- **There is a live producer.** `clone_permission_set` on `SysPermissionSet` (in `@objectstack/plugin-security`) declares `carryOver: true` on `object_permissions`, `field_permissions`, `system_permissions`, `row_level_security` and `tab_permissions`, both on objectstack `main` and in the **published** `@objectstack/plugin-security@17.4.0` tarball (its `dist/index.mjs` carries `field: "row_level_security", defaultFromRow: true, carryOver: true`). `description` is deliberately left editable by the producer. So the Clone dialog now shows **three** ordinary inputs (display name, API name, description) plus five read-only summaries. The card body says "two ordinary text inputs". This renderer follows the declaration and does not keep a list of names.
- **Why the key never reached the dialog.** `resolveActionParam()` builds its output key by key, so `carryOver` was dropped before the dialog ever saw the param. `ActionParamDialog.tsx` read it 0 times. The dialog reads `@object-ui/core`'s `ActionParamDef` (the resolved shape), not the spec type and not `@object-ui/types`. `@object-ui/types`' `ActionParam` already derives from `z.input` of the spec schema, so it gained `carryOver` with no edit.

## What changes

- `@object-ui/core`: `ActionParamDef.carryOver?: boolean`, documented against the spec key.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`:
  - `resolveActionParams.ts`: the `RawActionParam` mirror declares `carryOver`, and all three output branches (inline, field-backed, unresolved field) copy it.
  - `ActionParamDialog.tsx`: a carry-over param returns **before** `paramToField()`, so no widget is built for it. It renders as a Shadcn `Collapsible`, closed by default, with a trigger line (label, lock icon, `actionDialog.carryOverHint`). When expanded, it shows the value verbatim in a `pre`. The value lives only in the dialog's seeded `values`. `serializeParamValues` exempts carry-over params from the upload id reduction, so "verbatim" holds on every field type.
  - `metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx`: the designer's dialog mock says it draws the widget the dialog will render. After this change a carry-over param has no such widget, so the mock draws a read-only "carried over" line instead of the field's input. Without this, the mock would have been made false by this PR.
  - `README.md`: the ActionParamDialog section documents the key.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: one key, `actionDialog.carryOverHint`, in all ten packs.
- `.changeset/6246-action-param-carry-over.md`: app-shell, core and i18n all `minor`, the same class as the objectui#10129 precedent, which also added a key to `ActionParamDef` and to the i18n packs.

## Pins: `ActionParamDialog.carryOver-6246.test.tsx`

The fixture is the Clone action's `params` transcribed from `SysPermissionSet`. `@objectstack/plugin-security` is not a dependency of this repo, so the fixture is **parsed through the installed `ActionParamSchema`**, and a refusal control proves that parse can fail.

- Leg A (resolver): every carried facet resolves with `carryOver: true` and the row value as its seed. Control: the undeclared params resolve without it. The inline and unresolved-field branches carry it too.
- Leg B (what Clone **renders**): each facet is a `param-carry-over-FACET` block with zero `input` / `textarea` / `select` / `contenteditable` elements and no textbox. No control anywhere is labelled by the facet. The block is collapsed (`aria-expanded="false"`, value not in the DOM). Dialog-wide, the editable controls by identity are exactly `description`, `label` and `name`. Expanding shows the value and still has nothing editable in it. Control: the ordinary params of the same dialog are an `INPUT`, an `INPUT` and a `TEXTAREA` seeded from the row.
- Leg C (what Clone **submits**): Confirm sends each facet `toBe` the row string. The typed label and name go through, `description` is seeded, and `admin_scope` is absent. A carried upload value is not reduced to its id. Control: an ordinary upload param still is.
- Leg D (designer): the `ActionPreview` mock draws the read-only line for a carry-over param and no `textarea`, and the ordinary param beside it still draws its text box.

**Red before the fix**, at the base plus the test file only: `Tests 6 failed | 4 passed (10)`. Legs A and B are red and the upload leg is red. The submit leg was already green, which is expected: an untouched seeded textarea was always sent verbatim. That leg is a guarantee pin, not the gap.

**Ablations** go through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor has to hit, the blob hash has to move, and each restore is proven by `blob == HEAD` plus an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| mutation | red | green |
|---|---|---|
| dialog ignores `carryOver` (`if (false && rawParam.carryOver)`) | leg B read-only, leg B expand (2) | all controls, leg A, leg C (8) |
| `serializeParamValues` ignores it (line deleted) | the carried-upload pin (1) | 9 others |
| resolver drops it on all 3 branches (3 hits deleted) | leg A x2, leg B x2 (4) | controls, fixture parse, leg C (6) |
| designer mock ignores it | leg D (1) | 10 others |

**Reverse type check**: planting `carryOverX: true` beside `carryOver: true` in an `ActionParamDef` literal of the test turns `tsc -p packages/app-shell/tsconfig.test.json` red: `TS2561 ... 'carryOverX' does not exist in type 'ActionParamDef'. Did you mean to write 'carryOver'?`. That program lists the test file (1 hit in `--listFiles`, 4604 files) and resolves core through the rebuilt `packages/core/dist/actions/ActionRunner.d.ts`. The tree was restored and proven clean.

**Send-side contract**: objectstack#11703's pin 6 (`packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts` in `@objectstack/plugin-security`) is untouched. It lives in objectstack, reads only objectstack's action definition, and this diff changes no objectstack file. It was **not re-run here**.

## Local verification (test union after the final commit)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/ packages/i18n/ --maxWorkers=2` at `c11f8d5d`: `Test Files 232 passed (232)`, `Tests 4541 passed (4541)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --maxWorkers=2` at `c11f8d5d`: `Test Files 754 passed (754)`, `Tests 7461 passed | 1 skipped (7462)`.
- New pin plus the `ActionParamDialog` / resolver / `paramToField` / `paramValueShape` / `useConsoleActionRuntime` neighbours: 20 files, 338 tests green. The `metadata-admin/previews/` directory plus the ActionDesigner param tests: 61 files, 702 tests green.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/core --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 32 successful, 32 total` (dependency closure built first). Re-run at `c11f8d5d` after the last source edit: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (1 key added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:test-path-roots`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0 at `c11f8d5d`.
- Lint was narrowed to the changed files, and the narrowing is measured:
  - The population comes from `eslint.config.js`, whose TS block is `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`. The two changed `.md` files are outside it.
  - `--format json` reports 15 files with 0 errors, the same counts as the base on the files compared. With `--no-inline-config`, `ActionPreview.tsx` shows 2 errors at both the base and this head. These are the two `react-hooks/static-components` lines that the file already disables inline.
  - No untouched file's verdict can change: the config uses `tseslint.configs.recommended` with no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware, and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the disk.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-snippets` all refused as PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because the whole workspace is unbuilt in this worktree (their own "run the build first" refusal). The README addition is a JSON fence with no import binding. Their verdict belongs to CI.

## Scope notes

- The claim's file surface names the dialog, its tests, "the param type it reads" and one changeset. This PR also touches these files:
  - `resolveActionParams.ts`, the `RawActionParam` mirror plus the pass-through. Without it the declaration cannot reach the dialog.
  - the ten locale packs, for the one new key.
  - the app-shell README, per AGENTS.md #2.
  - `ActionPreview.tsx`, which this change would otherwise have made false.
- None of these files is in any open PR's file list, read at 2026-09-24T14:35Z.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed: the action designer's param inspector does not offer a `carryOver` toggle. An author has to write the key in the JSON source. Nobody has picked this up.
